workshoptitle: Build Student Success Intelligence with Oracle AI Database 26ai

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Follow one student-support operations workflow from shared context to coordinated review and planning.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Open Database Actions SQL Worksheet as LLUSER.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Student Success Data Foundation with Relational SQL
tutorials.description: Establish the shared foundation and compare current support pressure by academic program.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Student Success Command Center with Relational SQL
tutorials.description: Prioritize the request queue and identify students and services for staff review.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Student Requests and Cases with JSON Relational Duality
tutorials.description: Create and update a request document, then verify the committed relational result.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Student Intent and Support Signals with AI Vector Search
tutorials.description: Match a student's stated need to candidate services for staff review.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Advisor, Program, and Support Network with Property Graph
tutorials.description: Identify advocate and program relationships that could support coordinated follow-up.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Campus Service Coverage with Oracle Spatial
tutorials.description: Compare nearby service sites and current capacity before detailed routing checks.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Predictive Student-Service Demand with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Review predicted service demand and model disagreements for planning attention.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Conclusion
tutorials.description: Summarize the connected workflow, adaptable indicators, and adoption requirements.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding of the active labs.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
